integrity: Analytic infinite-parameter proof and exact Zak normalization; 72,421 finite numerical consistency assertions from the standalone checker. No claim of independent validation.
scientific_limitations: The twofold rectangular lattice and unnormalized order-two causal exponential family alone; no uniformity over other lattices, arbitrary shape orders, or unique minimizer of the shape condition number. Full Janssen (1996) source not accessible; novelty subject to that risk.
title: Exact twofold Gabor bounds and two-ended conditioning laws for causal Erlang windows
